correctness.rationale: The strip clipping model is exact for every central plane; absolute vertex projection order is proved on the full symmetry wedge; positive/negative outside vertex runs are contiguous and determine all cap/lateral face intersections; Haar polar geometry gives F_q and elementary integration gives five arcsine quantities. All q>0 and boundary null sets addressed. Independently executed edge-sign and quadrature checks agree.

originality.rationale: No direct covering theorem found in published-finding corpus and accessible classical source. Historical Voss/Ohser studies employ isotropic affine-plane or particle-ensemble sampling, which does not logically determine center-conditioned plane probabilities. However inaccessible full texts and stereological tables remain material residual priority risks; this PASS is a best-knowledge assessment rather than uniqueness certification.

value.rationale: A complete six-class joint face-incidence law and exact four-point side-count spectrum for all aspect ratios of a natural uniform-solid family, resolving both same-side-count cap ambiguities and the previously unspecified exact heptagonal probability. Closed expressions and positive regimes are mathematically interpretable and immediately reproducible.
